About.body: ARQUA is an international design & build firm specializing in architecture, interior design and construction management. We deliver exceptional spaces tailored to our clients' vision and lifestyle.

WhyUs.heading: What Sets Us Apart
WhyUs.r2Body: Concept, design, construction and turnkey — under one roof.
WhyUs.r3Body: Spaces tailored to each client's vision and lifestyle.
WhyUs.r4Body: World-class brands, meticulous detail and timeless materials.

FAQ.heading: What You're Wondering About
FAQ.q1: How long does a typical project take?
FAQ.a1: Residential projects take 8-14 months from concept to delivery; commercial projects 6-12 months depending on scope.
FAQ.a2: Yes, we operate across 5 countries: Azerbaijan, Türkiye, Russia, Georgia and the UAE.
FAQ.q3: Do you handle architecture and interior design together?
FAQ.a3: Yes. Architecture, interior design and construction come as a single integrated service.
FAQ.a4: After an initial consultation, we provide a detailed estimate based on scope, materials and timeline.
FAQ.q5: Can you work with my existing space or plans?
FAQ.a5: Yes. We can renovate, expand or refine existing designs to match your vision.
FAQ.q6: What does the turnkey service include?
FAQ.a6: Design, permits, construction, finishes and final furnishing — fully ready to move in.
